claim_boundary: Connected components are source-declared identifier/relation families only. They do not establish shared causal responsibility, author intent, scientific action or statistical independence beyond non-splitting of visible metadata links.

prospective_status.reason: Freeze exact source-family construction before invoking the row gateway.

source_family_construction.alias_collision: A normalized DOI co-declared with more than one distinct PMID, or a PMID co-declared with more than one distinct DOI, marks the entire connected component CANNOT_CHECK_IDENTIFIER_ALIAS_AMBIGUITY. No direction or equivalence is guessed.
source_family_construction.canonical_component_root: Lexicographically smallest original DOI if present, else lexicographically smallest original PMID, else CANNOT_CHECK.
source_family_construction.duplicate_relation: After alias union, repeated identical directed original-notice edges are one relation; later row occurrences are DUPLICATE_RELATION_KEY.
source_family_construction.endpoint_alias_rule: Within one RW row and one endpoint role, valid DOI and PMID identifiers are source-declared aliases. Union only those exact co-declared identifiers; do not use title, author, date, fuzzy text, external inference or identifier resolution.
source_family_construction.family_rule: A source family is a weakly connected component of the resulting bipartite original-notice endpoint graph, including shared notices and update chains. This supersedes the base protocol family_key shorthand solely to prevent a source-connected component from being split across statistical units or waves.
source_family_construction.relation_edge_rule: Each structurally eligible row adds one directed original-endpoint to notice-endpoint edge after source-declared alias union.
source_family_construction.role_collision: An endpoint identity appearing as both original and notice anywhere marks the connected component CANNOT_CHECK_ORIGINAL_NOTICE_ROLE_COLLISION.
source_family_construction.self_relation: An edge whose original and notice endpoints collapse to one alias set is excluded as CANNOT_CHECK_SELF_RELATION.
